name: Sanchidrián (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally crimson over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sanchidrián (musical notes and an eagle on white, with the motto Sanchidrián, Cuna de los Victoria).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 10 September 1993 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 243 of 21 December 1993), designed by Basilio Prados Migueláñez together with the anthem; the flag is a square flag divided horizontally crimson and blue, with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre.

features.role: Sanchidrián arms — musical notes and eagle, with motto
